title: A website theme never styles the public Space page, the public event page or Network sections on a Frequency page
detail: Finishes LIVE-1509 under the same owner rule (2026-10-27). The signed-out Space layout takes only the Space's own accent and fonts, the public event page no longer wears its host Space's website ground (lib/events/public-surface.ts is removed), and Network sections on a Frequency Space page take only their structural block sheet instead of the Network paper, scheme and faces. The walking test now covers app/(public)/spaces, app/(public)/events, components/spaces and components/frequency/members. Probe theme-surface.mjs (LIVE-1368) now holds the opposite of what it held, with the owner's word on the probe rewrite.

verify.evidence: Probe passes; vitest no-site-theme-in-member-area covers all five Frequency-hosted trees.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(p)=>fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8");const bad=[];if(/surface=\{|siteFaces=\{/.test(r("app/(public)/spaces/[slug]/layout.tsx")))bad.push("public Space layout passes a website theme");if(fs.existsSync("lib/events/public-surface.ts"))bad.push("public event surface still exists");if(/NETWORK_CSS\b|wearsNetwork/.test(r("components/spaces/network-page-scope.tsx")))bad.push("Network scope still wears the website look");if(bad.length){console.error(bad.join("; "));process.exit(1)}'
